# Retrospective: PR #12862

## What worked

Fresh Team 1 native sessions were verified before dispatch: Claude Code Opus 5 xhigh on the existing Claude Max route and Pi Astra xhigh. The coordinator read Herdr guidance and verified managed pane/team identity before lifecycle control. No other team or Work agent was touched. Neutral equivalent assignments, source pins and public issue context preserved initial independence. Both full independent reports were read before synthesis, with disagreement handled in separate follow-ups.

Native RE2 plus actual Lua helper emission was valuable. Hyprland source inspection rejected the tempting false finding that absent `pin=false` necessarily leaves fullscreen broken. Explicit synthetic map-state qualifiers prevent a model from masquerading as a live browser test. A positive scoped review was retained without generic test suggestions or future-browser speculation.

## Deviations, not concealed

Opus ran host-side bash syntax and Python AST fixture probes despite explicit prior instructions. The original prerequisite fixture continued after its first failed Lua prerequisite. Additional model fixture issues were lexical private-target checks, buffered nested RE2 output, optional engine fallback after a failed build and unchecked pipeline-child exits. A valid seal did not make these runs valid evidence.

The coordinator identified and reinforced the requirements, rejected narrowing the rule to reviewed software only, and conservatively excluded initial Opus runtime from public evidence. The original report and all 14 Opus bundles remain preserved. `reviewers/opus/follow-up-1.md` and `follow-up-1-summary.json` acknowledge each issue. The operative `ASSIGNMENT-CORRECTIONS.md` was propagated through the assignment-local `fixture-corrections.md` addendum. A newly pinned self-check inside review.py closed the host-probe gap. New fail-fast prerequisites and positive/negative tests also ran; one intermediate path-canonicalization setup failed and correctly aborted, was preserved, then corrected. `opus-remediation-audit.json` records final seals and child results.

No observed host services/configuration/hardware/accounts mutation, shared-resource interference, pattern killing or peer contamination. Nevertheless `safety_process_compliant=false` is accurate. Publication eligibility is separate from incident remediation: valid independent Astra runtime plus both source reviews support the exact narrow draft, so no extra posting permission or indefinite hold is justified by these process-only errors.

## Evidence policy and useful improvements

Start fixtures with a tested fail-fast helper that resolves every actual write target and streams each child output from process start. Reviewer-fixture syntax/import checks have no exemption from review.py. Preserve failed prerequisites and stop their cases immediately. A source-derived alternative must not be advertised as runtime-verified when its model evidence is excluded. Models may corroborate source, but agreement alone does not establish real desktop behavior.

The substantive disagreement was about retained PiP effects, not their existence. Border focus cues and opt-in pseudo-size/floating resize effects matter, but do not demonstrate failure of this map-time repair. The public draft records the retained-treatment limitation rather than reporting a misleading continuing fullscreen defect. Detailed alternative designs stay local.

## Tool issues and requests

No confirmed Herdr, review.py or Omadev product bug. The invalid Lua argument and readlink behavior were fixture mistakes. Astra's comprehensive direct-child output/exit manifest is the better pattern for future fixture authors. No desktop slot was needed or used. All command children completed, owned transient namespaces exited, and no persistent servers remain according to saved receipts. Agent panes and historical sessions are preserved for the outer assistant's next authorized reset.

## Editorial and presentation

Fresh Astra Medium editorial check `e896907e-e140-4e31-a0a6-2e9036763414` passed the exact final draft. No source or prior verdict was supplied. Public scope is explicitly not live fullscreen validation. HTML is saved without opening. Only the outer assistant may publish after final upstream and hash checks.
